**PRIOR AUTHORIZATION APPROVAL**

**Service:** Continuous Glucose Monitor  
**Order Date:** June 11, 2025  
**Decision:** APPROVED

---

**Clinical Criteria Met:**

**Diagnosis Requirement:** Met  
Patient has active Type 2 diabetes mellitus with hyperglycemia, diagnosed March 1, 2019 (ICD-10: E11.65).

**Treatment Requirement:** Met  
Patient is currently treated with insulin glargine 22 units at bedtime, initiated February 7, 2023.

**Visit Requirement:** Met  
In-person diabetes follow-up visit completed February 16, 2025 (115 days prior to order) with documented evaluation of glucose control and hypoglycemia risk. Clinical note by Dr. R. Castillo confirms continuous glucose monitoring was discussed.
